titulo: Phone face down when she sits
caption:
Phone face down when she sits

My sister puts her phone face down the second she sits at my table. Then I did it too.

Research on conversations has found that a phone merely sitting on the table lowered how close people felt to each other.

For whoever puts the phone face down first.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right, each looking down at a phone standing on the table, both buzzing. The black one looks up, and its phone lies face down with a small pulse. The blue one looks up with wide eyes, then lays its own phone face down, and a bubble says me too. Both end with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: me putting my phone down first. The last card: Choose friction.
